target: Distinguish peer MCP instances from ownership collisions in doctor/lifecycle preflight without weakening Task Orchestrator single-active-project policy
invariants: Foreign containers cannot be adopted as target-project services from name resemblance alone.
A container occupying a target project's expected port remains a hard blocker.
An exact expected container with wrong or unknown ownership remains fail-closed.
Task Orchestrator remains single_active_project on reserved port 7890.
No foreign container is automatically stopped.
Doctor remains read-only with respect to project settings, containers, and runtime state.
Docker-unavailable state cannot produce positive ownership claims.
Implementation must not introduce shared Task Orchestrator state or shared_singleton lifecycle actions.
Implementation must not add partial-start behavior.

execution.stacked_because: Supersedes PR #1086 with a narrow peer-instance classification fix; TO state_scope remains single_active_project.

pr.title: fix(mcp): distinguish peer MCP instances from ownership collisions
pr.body:
## Summary
- classify non-colliding peer ConPort/dope-memory containers as non-blocking findings
- keep DOCKER_CONTAINER_WRONG_PROJECT as a hard blocker for exact identity or port conflicts
- preserve Task Orchestrator single_active_project on port 7890
- supersede PR #1086 without adopting multi_project_singleton

## Authority
- ADR-DMX-MCP-PEER-PROJECT-PREFLIGHT-001
- TP-DMX-MCP-PEER-PROJECT-PREFLIGHT-001

## Validation
- pytest focused MCP doctor/lifecycle/docker inspect tests
- catalog TO state_scope remains single_active_project
- git diff --check

steps.task: Inspect doctor/lifecycle classification of foreign containers and PR #1086 scope boundary.
requirements: Confirm Task Orchestrator catalog state_scope remains single_active_project.
validation: Root-cause false-positive chain and ADR scope boundary documented before edits.

steps.task: Emit non-blocking peer findings for non-colliding family-name matches; keep hard blocks for identity/port conflicts; file ADR and tests.
requirements: Do not remove DOCKER_CONTAINER_WRONG_PROJECT from lifecycle blocking set.
Do not change Task Orchestrator to multi_project_singleton.
Do not introduce shared_singleton lifecycle actions or partial-start behavior.
validation: Focused tests prove peer vs collision distinction and TO policy preserved.

steps.task: Run allowlisted verification commands and confirm no TO state-scope drift.
requirements: All listed verify commands pass or report explicit NOT_RUN with reason.
commands: uv run --extra test pytest tests/unit/test_mcp_doctor_repo_aware.py tests/unit/test_mcp_lifecycle.py tests/unit/test_mcp_docker_inspect.py -q
validation: pytest exit 0; git diff --check exit 0; catalog state_scope unchanged.
